instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show one person's answers to a form across every time they answered, in order, and the trend of one numeric answer", and give it form_id (The form); respondent_id (The person whose answers to read); field_map (Output field name to questionId).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-answer-progress and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give form_id, respondent_id and field_map (the name you want for each answer, to its questionId), and optionally trend_field (which mapped answer to chart; default the first that is numeric).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: answer-fact (records:list).
